delegation.task: Add an intelligent in-app dataset viewer to the existing inspection dashboard so the operator never has to leave the dashboard to inspect the datasets behind an evaluation.

validations_executed.evidence: All prior dashboard assertions still pass, plus new dataset viewer assertions: page markup for the Datasets tab, navigator, viewer container, and API wiring; catalog groups for evaluations, targets, query-packs, site-profiles, platform, inspection-history, and run-datasets; targets/ridge.json parses with target_id field; inspection-history/GEN-013.jsonl parses as JSONL with inspection_id field; platform/capability-registry.json unwraps its capabilities array with P001 present; a generated run DS JSONL returns records; path traversal and non-JSON files are rejected with HTTP 400.
Contracts, manifests, platform, and inspection output validation all pass. Known warn-level notice remains: pre-cache-metadata Ridge run GEN-013-20260708T161237Z.
Existing framework validator passes; BDD-012 evaluator calibration remains a known deferred warning.

Verified in a live browser: Datasets tab switches views, dataset navigator lists all seven groups, deep link #dataset=inspection-history/GEN-013.jsonl&q=dress-up opens the file with the search prefilled and filters 4 of 8 records, clicking a row renders the full key-value record detail, and the DS1 View link on a Dress Up inspection opens the underlying ds1-canonical-search.jsonl records in the viewer. No console errors.

validations_skipped.reason: This slice is dashboard-only; no inspection logic changed. The Ridge blocked-domain pilot remains the next step in the frozen design pilot sequence.

notes: Dataset viewer is an implementation change after VAL-051, so the Validation Gate clean-pass count restarts: VAL-052 is clean pass one for the current implementation state. Phase exit still requires a second independent clean pass with no implementation changes in between, plus the GEN-013 BDD inventory refresh.
